behavior: Use only the existing pinned Node 24.22.0, npm 11.19.1, Vite 8.3.4 and TypeScript 7.0.2 workspace dependencies; do not add a registry dependency.

The inspector transform is explicitly opt-in and development/test only; preserve target semantics, never execute target source, mutate target files, start a target process, or emit source-map metadata in production.
BuildManifest contains source and anchor evidence only; it never contains an engine generation, runtime DOM instance, or resolver claim.

Parse and validate the complete manifest and source-generation binding before SQL writes; import map, anchors, binding and typed links atomically; exact repeat is idempotent and conflicting immutable content is rejected.
Apply index migrations 003 then 004 only on explicit UI-enabled open; keep the default core reader/writer at schema/reader v2 and reject v4 stores.
Keep C14N1 and MCE-MANIFEST-JSON1 exact-byte behavior aligned with the existing cross-language vectors; reject malformed Unicode, paths, ranges, duplicate IDs and overflows.
contracts: S38 UI store and immutable binding
exclusions: No Inspector interaction, SDK DOM registry, preview permissions, target execution, production transform, network service, release, or package publication.
No global schema-version bump: UI-enabled capability is explicit; core default remains v2.
No changes to sealed/historical artifacts, Git remotes, branch protection, credentials, or unrelated dirty/untracked work.

objective: Implement the opt-in Vite development AST transform and generation-independent BuildManifest producer, validate and atomically import immutable UI maps/bindings into the SQLite index, and prove production stripping and cross-language canonicalization.

verification_plan.evidence: Compare Go and Node full canonical bytes and SHA-256 against checked-in C14N1 and MANIFEST-JSON1 vectors, including rejection fixtures.
Build a Vite production fixture with opt-in set and prove the development transform, BuildManifest payload, inspector SDK references and injected attributes are absent from emitted output.
Normal push allocation, payload and closing commits; exact-SHA main and task-branch CI; sealed archive/readback and fresh live verification.
